answer: Identity = hash(pubkey || burn_tx) where burn_tx destroys 500 POA. Each epoch, identities must burn additional 10 to stay active. Attacker creating N identities burns N × 500 upfront + N × 10 per epoch, cost compounding. System verifies via burn transaction receipts on Base; duplicate detection via nullifier set. Voting power = log(1 + total_burned). Threshold 67 POA burned for eligibility. Words: dune, beacon, grove.
